decisions.reason: 已关注 means already following; Đã theo dõi preserves the completed state and is natural Vietnamese UI text.
关注 is the follow action; Theo dõi is concise and semantically exact for this UI label.
1年前以上 expresses a time older than one year; Hơn 1 năm trước preserves the lower-bound meaning.
1小时以内 means within one hour; Trong 1 giờ is a natural compact rendering with the same upper-bound meaning.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có Trainer được đề xuất
decisions.reason: 没有推荐的训练员 means there is no recommended Trainer; adding được makes the passive relationship explicit and removes the ambiguity in Không có Trainer đề xuất.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community term common.trainer requires the player-facing term Trainer and forbids Huấn luyện viên.

decisions.reason: 奖杯 means trophy/cup; Cúp is a concise natural Vietnamese UI label with the same meaning.
粉丝 is the fan label in this profile context; Fan is established, concise player-facing Vietnamese usage.
GOOD END达成数 is a count of GOOD END achievements; Số lần đạt GOOD END states the counted occurrences naturally and unambiguously.
历代最高评价点 denotes the highest evaluation score across past records; Điểm đánh giá cao nhất naturally carries the all-time maximum meaning in this profile statistic.
以往最高得分 means previous/all-time highest score; Điểm cao nhất is the standard concise equivalent for this statistic.
CLASS is already a Latin player-facing label; keeping CLASS {0} preserves both the intended label and placeholder structure exactly.
{0}pt is a compact value-plus-unit label already written in Latin characters; the placeholder and unit are preserved exactly.

decisions.proposed_text: Số fan của đối phương đã đạt giới hạn
decisions.reason: 对方的粉丝数达到上限 refers to the other party's fan count reaching its cap; the current text treats Fan as the subject and loses the explicit count meaning.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded locked term progress.fans maps 粉丝数 to Số fan and is currently marked absent, so the revision restores the required canonical term.

decisions.reason: 关注数达到上限 means the following-count limit has been reached; Đã đạt giới hạn theo dõi is a concise natural UI rendering of that state.
没有正在关注的训练员 means no Trainer is currently being followed; Chưa theo dõi Trainer nào conveys that state naturally.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community term common.trainer requires Trainer and forbids Huấn luyện viên; the current text satisfies it.
